title: 25,000 Humpback Whales Prove Protection Can Work
hook: One humpback population recovered to 25,000 after hunting stopped.
closing: Protection can rebuild a species, but only while people keep the danger away.
question: Should commercial whaling stay banned?

segments.say: The humpback population reached 25,000. Protection turned a near-erasure into a real comeback.
Ten humpback populations are fully recovered. Species recovery is difficult, but it is not hopeless.
Whalers killed 2.9 million large whales last century. Ending commercial hunting finally gave survivors room to rebuild.
